headline: Record sales and orders beat guidance, margins expand
summary_short: TE Connectivity's fiscal Q3 2026 net sales rose 13.8% y/y to a record $5,160M (12% organic), beating the company's own guidance, with GAAP diluted EPS of $2.55 (+19.2% y/y) and adjusted EPS of $2.94 (+22% y/y); GAAP operating margin rose to 19.0% (+10bp y/y, per the release) while orders hit a record $5.7B, up 27% y/y.
summary_long: Both segments grew: Industrial Solutions net sales rose to $2,580M (+22.0% y/y, GAAP margin 20.8% vs 18.7%); Transportation rose to $2,580M (+6.7% y/y, GAAP margin 17.2% vs 19.1%). GAAP operating margin was 19.0% (+10bp y/y); adjusted operating margin expanded 90bp to 22% on strong operational performance. Record orders of $5.7B (+27% y/y) reflected double-digit growth in all businesses, including AI-driven data-center and energy-infrastructure demand. Free cash flow was $883M this quarter; the company repurchased $529M of shares and paid $226M of dividends. TE agreed to acquire Astrodyne TDI (~$250M annual sales, ~$1.4B price) for the Industrial segment, closing by calendar year-end. Q4 FY26 guidance: sales ~$5.25B (+11% y/y), adjusted EPS ~$3.05 (+18% y/y), GAAP EPS ~$2.84 (+27% y/y).
